name: Top Welcome Screens
tagline: Open-source React Native welcome animations inspired by leading iOS apps
description: Top Welcome Screens is an open-source collection of animated splash screens, loading screens, welcome screens, and onboarding UI studies inspired by leading iOS apps. It rebuilds ten welcome-screen designs with React Native and Expo so they are ready to drop into a mobile app. Built on Expo SDK 57 and React Native 0.86 with strict TypeScript, the project is a practical reference and component library for onboarding experiences. Each screen is a study of a top-performing iOS app's onboarding, giving developers a curated starting point rather than a blank canvas. The repo includes a live Expo gallery to preview and explore the screens, copy-paste prompts for reproducing each design, and is MIT-licensed or GPL-3.0 (per the code) with a CI pipeline.
highlights: Ten animated welcome, splash, and onboarding screens rebuilt with React Native and Expo
Design studies inspired by leading iOS apps, ready to drop into a mobile project
Built on Expo SDK 57 and React Native 0.86 with strict TypeScript
Live Expo gallery to preview and explore each screen
Includes copy-paste prompts for reproducing each design in your own app
curatorNote: Onboarding is where most mobile apps lose users, and this library hands you ten polished, proven designs instead of a blank screen. The copy-paste prompts and live Expo gallery make it genuinely practical — a great starting point whether you are prototyping or shipping a real onboarding flow.
